topic: The anime studio that went bankrupt the very day their masterpiece released
hook: Their masterpiece released the same day they went bankrupt.
script: Their masterpiece released the same day they went bankrupt. Manglobe Studio produced critically acclaimed anime including Samurai Champloo and Ergo Proxy. Their final work, Gangsta, was considered their best. It aired its final episode on the same day Manglobe filed for bankruptcy in 2015. The staff had not been paid for months. They finished the show anyway. The studio closed. The show was never completed. Follow for anime industry stories that break your heart.
